description.value: Reckless Bike Stores is a full-service Vancouver bike shop selling, servicing, and renting a wide range of bicycles from drop-bar gravel bikes to cargo and folding bikes. They are an authorized Rad Power Bikes service centre and offer both road performance and city/e-bike rentals. The shop stocks touring-relevant accessories including pannier bags and carries an extensive pre-owned inventory.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Reckless Bike Stores is an active full-service bike shop with a dedicated Service section ('Rad Bike Service', 'Bikes and eBikes'), rental offerings ('Performance Road Rentals', 'City Rentals & eBike Rentals'), and accessories including 'Pannier Bags' — all sourced from the site navigation. However, the fetched content was dominated by the country/currency selector and navigation menus; substantive body text from service, contact, and hours pages was not captured, limiting evidence for many amenity details. The OSM record has no phone number and the website's contact page content was truncated.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM record and website contact page content was truncated — phone cannot be confirmed.
Website references 'Our Locations' (plural), suggesting multiple shop locations; this OSM node represents only the 1810 Fir Street location.
Fetched website content was almost entirely navigation menus and a currency-selector list; substantive service/contact page body text was not captured, limiting amenity evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Reckless Bike Stores is an established full-service Vancouver bike shop with clear service, rental, and touring-accessory offerings — a strong candidate for the WWC directory. A touring cyclist would find repairs, e-bike service, rentals, and pannier bags all under one roof.
enrichment_extras.notes: A follow-up manual visit to reckless.ca/pages/contact or the locations page would resolve phone number, exact address confirmation, walk-in repair policy, and pump/washroom availability.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Website accessories menu explicitly lists 'Pannier Bags'; also stocks drop-bar and gravel bikes and vehicle racks

E-bike service.detail: Dedicated 'Rad Bike Service' subpage (/pages/rad-power-bikes-service) and 'Service Bikes and eBikes' menu item confirm e-bike servicing

Bike rentals.detail: Website Rentals menu lists 'Performance Road Rentals' and 'City Rentals & eBike Rentals'
